study_type: moderated task-based usability / decision-comprehension test with async self-report fallback
replan_reason: Flux moved from a cross-border treasury console to advances, reimbursements and vendor payments in a Vietnamese SME. The earlier plan targeted treasury and finance-operations participants and used USD data that no longer exists. No session had been run, so nothing was discarded.
pilot: Run one pilot session (FLX-PILOT) before FLX-P01 to check the Vietnamese wording, the English UI and the timing. The pilot is not counted as evidence.
preferred_population: employees, team leads, accountants and directors or owners in Vietnamese companies of up to about 200 staff who, in the last 6 months, asked for, approved, checked or paid out advances, reimbursements or vendor payments
proxy_rule: People who did this work only in companies above about 200 staff, or who approve similar requests without money (leave, purchase requests), remain PROXY and may not be promoted to DIRECT_USER.
language_note: The Flux interface is in English and participants are Vietnamese. Record English reading comfort at screening and tag any finding caused by language rather than design.
form_policy: Use FLUX-NATIVE-FORM.md as the only participant questionnaire for Round 01. Do not reuse, map or adapt the Nova form or the earlier treasury version of this form.
method_policy: MODERATED sessions may support observed-behavior evidence. ASYNC_SELF_REPORT responses remain self-report and may not be converted into observed task success, timing or moderator-help claims.
build_policy: Record the exact prototype URL/build used for every participant and do not silently change builds within a comparison round.
iteration_gate: Do not claim an evidence-driven iteration until verified real-session evidence is traceable. Prefer synthesis after 3-5 verified DIRECT_USER sessions; preserve PROXY evidence separately.
retest_gate: After a named decision changes, freeze the changed build and run the same affected task with new or explicitly marked returning participants before claiming improvement.
allowed_claims: A recruiter-facing design lens exists with decision pins, conceptual baseline/current comparison, a five-step tour and forced states
A Flux-native direct-user validation round for small-company spend requests is ready to recruit
One canonical Round 01 participant form exists for D-01 through D-05
Direct-user evidence has not been collected yet
forbidden_claims_until_verified: Flux has been validated by office staff, team leads or accountants
Flux reduces payment or reimbursement mistakes
Flux helps advances get settled faster
The payout recovery model improves task success
